extensionDescription.message: Read QR codes from images with a right-click, or select an area of a page. Decode locally and preview before opening links.

offscreenJustification.message: Read images locally and run a QR decoding Worker in an offscreen extension document, with results displayed on the page.

loadingImage.message: Reading the image and decoding locally…

selectionInstructions.message: Drag around the QR code and release to scan. Include the blank margin. Press Esc or right-click to cancel.

selectionHint.message: Drag around the QR code and release to scan. Press Esc or right-click to cancel.

selectionDialog.message: Select a QR code. Press Esc or right-click to cancel.

selectionTip.message: Drag to select · Release to scan · Esc / right-click to cancel

selectionTooSmall.message: Selection too small. Include the entire QR code and its blank margin.

selectionRetrySmall.message: Selection too small. Drag around the entire QR code again.

checkBeforeOpening.message: Check the content before opening the link.

scannerCheckBeforeOpening.message: Check the content before deciding whether to open the link.

screenshotResults.message: These results are from the page screenshot. Check that they match your intended QR code.

scannerScreenshotResults.message: Could not read the original image. Distinct results found in the page screenshot: $count$. Check that they match your intended QR code.

copyManually.message: Select the content and press Ctrl+C to copy.

scannerCopyManually.message: Select the content above and press Ctrl+C to copy.

retryAdvice.message: Try zooming in and taking another screenshot. Include all four corners of the QR code.

privacyFooter.message: Images and decoded content are not uploaded · Press Esc to cancel

errorInvalidSelection.message: Invalid selection. Select the QR code again.

errorExpiredJob.message: This scan task has ended. Click the extension icon again.

errorDecode.message: Local decoding could not be completed.

errorPanel.message: The in-page result panel is unavailable.

errorTabChanged.message: The active tab changed. Scan again in the tab containing the QR code.

errorSelectionUnavailable.message: Selection is unavailable on this page.

errorCapture.message: Could not capture the current page: $details$

errorImageUnavailable.message: Could not read this image. Click the extension icon to select an area of the page screenshot.

errorRequestSource.message: This request source is not allowed.

errorJobPage.message: The page does not match this task.

errorJobRead.message: Only the extension popup can read image tasks.

errorWebURL.message: Only valid HTTP or HTTPS web links can be opened.

errorDisconnected.message: The extension connection was lost. Reload the extension.

errorScannerDisconnected.message: The extension connection was lost. Open the extension again.

errorNoScreenshot.message: No screenshot is available. Return to the page and click the extension icon again.

errorImageFormat.message: Could not read this image format. Select an area of the page screenshot instead.

errorImageDenied.message: The image server rejected the request ($status$).

errorImageTooLarge.message: The original image is too large. Select an area of the page screenshot instead.

errorImageTimeout.message: Reading the original image timed out. Select an area of the page screenshot instead.

errorDecodeTimeout.message: Scanning is taking too long. Select a smaller area and try again.

errorWorkerStart.message: The decoder could not start. Reload the extension.

errorNoCode.message: No readable QR code found. Select the entire code with its blank margin, avoiding obstructions and blurry areas.

errorRetryScreenshot.message: $details$ You can select another area of the screenshot.

errorDecoderRead.message: Could not load the fallback decoder. Reload the extension.

progressScreenshotFallback.message: Could not read the original image. Trying the page screenshot…
